criterion: Change the visible coverage layer; the chosen coverage remains visible after the layer panel is closed.
steps_taken: Captured the initial GIS state, selected Network Information with Add layer, and verified Network Information appeared in the Map layers stack and coverage was visible on the map.
actual_result: Network Information was added and remained visible in the map-layer stack with coverage rendered on the map.

criterion: Close the layer panel; the selected coverage remains visible on the map.
steps_taken: Attempted the available panel/menu control and captured the resulting map state.
actual_result: The captured state did not provide decisive direct evidence that the layer panel itself was closed.
blockers: The current UI did not expose a distinct accessible layer-panel close control; the available top-left control opened the application menu.

criterion: Adjust the map and change tools; map navigation keeps its current position.
steps_taken: Clicked the map Zoom in control and captured the changed map view.
actual_result: The map view changed through navigation while the selected coverage layer remained rendered.

criterion: Return to the default view; the starting area is restored and the map controls remain available.
steps_taken: Clicked the visible north/reset map control and captured the resulting state.
actual_result: The reset control was exercised and the map controls remained available in the captured state.
